in_marathi.name: Subhojit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे New Beginning, Auspicious
in_marathi.long_meaning: Subhojit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Subho means new beginning and auspicious. Jit means victory. Subhojit means one who has achieved a new beginning or has the auspicious qualities of a victor.

in_bengali.name: Subhojit
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ New Beginning, Auspicious
in_bengali.long_meaning: Subhojit একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Subho means new beginning and auspicious. Jit means victory. Subhojit means one who has achieved a new beginning or has the auspicious qualities of a victor.
